chapter_number.means: the chapter's number above its title (“I”…; empty — the prologue, the epilogue)

chapter_title.means: the chapter's title, carved on the wall

map.means: null — the title only; otherwise the rows of the chapter's choices: [{title, weight '⚑'|'~', options: [{label, state: 'chosen'|'open'|'unseen'}]}] — the crack runs through the chosen, a hairline to the open, a barely visible line to the unreached

reveal.means: how far the crack has come down the wall: 0 — none, 1 — to the bottom of the frame; a row's words — once it has reached them

knot.means: the brightness of the crack's end (the element knot), once the crack has reached it
